name: slskd
description: Soulseek client in your browser for finding and sharing music

paths.name: App
paths.description: slskd's options file (slskd.yml), its database, logs and this install's own keys (secrets.env, .web_password). Back it up.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: slskd web UI and API, published on host as 6779

ports.name: Port 6780
ports.description: Soulseek peer connections, published on host as 6780

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: The user id that owns the app's files. 500 is the MOS default.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: The group id that owns the app's files. 500 is the MOS default.

variables.name: SLSKD_SLSK_USERNAME
variables.description: Your Soulseek user name. Pick any free name: the account is made the first time it signs in.

variables.name: SLSKD_PASSWORD
variables.description: The web UI password (user name slskd). Leave it empty and one is made for you: it is shown in the app's logs, in the box marked CREDENTIALS.

variables.name: SLSKD_SLSK_LISTEN_PORT
variables.description: The port other Soulseek users connect to. Keep it 6780, the same as the published port. Forward it on your router for the best results.
